mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months indicates an easing monetary policy stance, which reduces long-term interest rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals labor market weakness, reducing corporate profit margins and dampening stock valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns despite UNRATE exceeding 5.5% in the labor market stress regime.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate decreases while quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) rises, it signals accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive over 60 days when FEDFUNDS <3.0% and GDPC1 >11000, with a p-value >0.05 in a t-test.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates labor market tightness, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative over 20 days despite UNRATE falling below 4.0% in the late-cycle expansion regime, with a t-test p-value >0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Rising labor participation rates (PAYEMS) correlate with increased economic activity and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive over 5 days when PAYEMS is rising, with a p-value >0.05.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 120 signals robust supply-side growth, enhancing corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative over 20 days despite INDPRO exceeding 120, with a t-test p-value >0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When both demand (RSAFS) and supply (INDPRO) indices rise simultaneously, it indicates balanced growth in the economy, fostering optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive over 60 days when both RSAFS >350000 and INDPRO >118.64, with a p-value >0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates increase borrowing costs, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive over 20 days despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 3.5% in the tightening cycle, with a t-test p-value >0.05.
